# DMCLUSTER

Another name for TWOSTEP CLUSTER.

## Syntax

```text
DMCLUSTER takes the subcommands of TWOSTEP CLUSTER and runs it.
```

## Example

```text
DMCLUSTER /CONTINUOUS VARIABLES=spend visits /PRINT=COUNT.
```

`statscraft help DMCLUSTER` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
